status: development, non-confirmatory (ISU is not blind, PREREG 3.4); never evidence for Samsung
spec: PREREG_v4 17.2 C6 and section 12 rule 10; debates/D016_roles/02_judge.md (P6 lines 173, 320, 342, 384); debates/D016_roles/01_proposal.md 5.6; reading rule in runs/pilot_P6/RULE.md
window_W_weeks_note: tuning (inner CV) window and backbone-tournament window: W = 2 weeks as run.py does at m < 32 (rule_tune)
score_windows_note: ISU analogue of k in {0, 2, k_full}: W = 0 weeks (reference only), 2 weeks (g1 analogue, PREREG 4.1 / 1: scarce analogue), full = base window W = 4 weeks (data.WindowRule.for_grid)

reading_rule.primary_comparison: A1 against D* (D* = arm of {A9, A11, A12} with the lowest inner-CV condition-mean score on the side's pseudo-train, selectors.select_comparators)
reading_rule.side_statistic: median over the side's pseudo-test conditions of the ensemble condition score (pp), conditions scored by both arms
reading_rule.data_leads_on_side: median(D*) <= median(A1), i.e. A1 is not lower than D*
reading_rule.stop_rule_10: triggered iff data_leads_on_side on at least 3 of the 5 sides; no margin
